label: Custom Uniswap v4 hook
summary: Start a canonical v4 pool whose custom hook implements only the pool behavior preserved by project intent.
requiredFacts: Why each enabled callback is necessary
The exact PoolKey, permission mask and hook address derivation
All currency flows, settlement rules, authorities and exits
How custom behavior composes with any fee behavior explicitly selected by preserved intent or the current central policy
risks: Callback or accounting mistakes can affect every swap
Custom routing or hookData can narrow provider support
